definition: struct_weight[s] = clip( (1/N_atoms[s]) / geomean_s(1/N_atoms), 1/sqrt(8), sqrt(8) ); implemented via one unique str_list tag per structure (weight = that clipped value). Applied in TRAINING only (SIMPLE-NN uses uniform weights for validation).

rationale_vs_criteria.1_no_production_domination: production force share 32%->18.6% (7 lineages no longer dominate)
rationale_vs_criteria.2_deployment_relevance_preserved: production retained at 18.6% (pure 1/N would erase it to 2%)
rationale_vs_criteria.4_simple_reproducible: one clip formula, one parameter (range=8); deterministic
rationale_vs_criteria.7_no_teacher_labels: weights are functions of N_atoms only

energy_side_effect: 1/N weighting mildly up-weights small cells in ENERGY loss; bounded to 8x so effect is modest; energy is per-atom-normalized already. Monitored in PC004.
contingency: if PC004 shows amorphous or large-cell underfit, add a modest per-domain multiplier (Policy C+domain) or relax the cap; do NOT change without PC004 evidence
implementation_artifact: str_list generator will emit one [struct_id : weight] tag per selected structure at PC002-labeling/preprocess time (after final teacher labels exist)
